summary: Master the art of leadership in our Strategy and Innovation Course. Equip yourself with the tools to implement effective strategies and foster innovation.
lede: Strategy and innovation training helps experienced professionals turn organizational priorities into coordinated plans and practical initiatives. Participants learn to scan markets, shape value propositions, manage innovation pipelines, set objectives and measures, and align stakeholders around execution and change using tools such as the Balanced Scorecard, OKRs and Hoshin Kanri.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for shaping the direction of their business units or entire organizations.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of professional experience in a management or specialist role. A basic understanding of business finance and organizational structure is required. No prior experience with specific frameworks like ISO 56002 or the Balanced Scorecard® is necessary, as these will be taught from an operational perspective.
